params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. Anonymous callers are limited to `view` and `embed`.

params.name: namespace
params.description: Restrict the response to a single namespace.

items.docs: Returns the site index — name, description, URL, home, the registered namespaces, the supported authentication methods (WordPress application passwords), the site logo and icon, and the full 198-entry route table.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. Anonymous callers are limited to `view` and `embed`.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of items to be returned in the result set.

params.name: search
params.description: Limit results to those matching a string.

params.name: search_columns
params.description: Array of column names to be searched.

params.name: exclude
params.description: Ensure result set excludes specific IDs.

params.name: include
params.description: Limit result set to specific IDs.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset the result set by a specific number of items.

params.name: order
params.description: Order sort attribute ascending or descending.

params.name: slug
params.description: Limit result set to items with one or more specific slugs.

params.name: has_published_posts
params.description: Limit result set to users who have published posts.

items.docs: Lists the users who have published content. Anonymous callers receive the `embed`-level public author projection only — id, name, url, description, link, slug and avatar URLs. No email addresses, roles or capabilities are exposed anonymously. Three authors were listed at harvest time.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. Anonymous callers are limited to `view` and `embed`.

items.docs: Returns the registered post types keyed by name. Fourteen are registered on this deployment: post, page, attachment, nav_menu_item, wp_block, wp_template, wp_template_part, wp_global_styles, wp_navigation, wp_font_family, wp_font_face, plus Belharra's three custom types company-news, multimedia-file and press-release.

params.name: context
params.description: Scope under which the request is made; determines fields present in the response. Anonymous callers are limited to `view` and `embed`.

params.name: type
params.description: Limit results to taxonomies associated with a specific post type.

items.docs: Returns the registered taxonomies keyed by name — category, post_tag, nav_menu and wp_pattern_category. Note that none of Belharra's three custom post types declares a taxonomy.

items.docs: Returns the post statuses visible anonymously. Two are exposed on this deployment — `publish` and `acf-disabled` (an Advanced Custom Fields status).
